answer.rationale: Use the confirmed activation-messaging intervention: it improved week-one engagement by 11%, activation by 6%, and 30-day retention by 1%. Reject promotional pricing despite its acquisition lift because the verified discounted cohort had 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle, conflicting with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective. The evidence does not establish that activation messaging will fully offset price-driven churn, so that uncertainty should be monitored.
